_comment: Small demo signature set for educational use. 'max_vulnerable' means versions <= that value are flagged. Not a live CVE feed.

signatures.description: OpenSSH versions before 8.0 contain several known vulnerabilities; upgrade recommended.
vsftpd 2.3.4 shipped with a malicious backdoor granting a root shell on port 6200.
Apache httpd 2.2.x is end-of-life and no longer receives security updates.
nginx before 1.20 misses several security fixes; upgrade to a current stable release.
Microsoft IIS 7.5 and earlier are outdated and have multiple known issues.
Exim before 4.92 is vulnerable to remote command execution (The Return of the WIZard).
MySQL 5.6 and earlier are end-of-life; upgrade to a supported release.
